atoms.statement: Replace Test-IsLargeTask internals with a scope profile (acceptance_count, number of subsystems, estimated_turns, files) with optional params and early-return for child atoms, enabling mandatory bridge-self decomposition only when Channel=='main' AND Scope=='bridge'.
atoms.test: Verify Test-IsLargeTask uses scope profile metrics (acceptance_count, subsystems, estimated_turns, files) with optional params, early-returns for child atoms, and activates only for main/bridge.

atoms.statement: Use Add-ProjectBacklogFromMarker(Channel='main') as the sole atom-ingest path, extending it with additive bridge-self validation and per-atom return records (valid_for_split, files, source_task_id, action, errors) branched on Channel=='main'.
atoms.test: Verify Add-ProjectBacklogFromMarker is the sole ingest path for bridge-self (Channel='main'), and it includes additive bridge-self validation and per-atom return records.

atoms.statement: Implement exactly one mandatory gate in driver/86-loop-completion-actions.ps1, with a predicate (channel=='main', scope=='bridge', large, not child atom), to block monolith coding for invalid splits, mark parent decomposed for valid splits, force bounded decompose-retry with ingest errors, and operator-hold on exhaustion.
atoms.category: Gating Logic / Mandatory Decomposition / Retry Logic
atoms.test: Verify the single mandatory gate in 86-loop-completion-actions.ps1 correctly applies its predicate, blocks monolith for invalid splits, forces bounded retry, and holds on exhaustion.

atoms.statement: Children of an approved decomposed parent are created with approved status and tagged bridge-self, verifying existing Add-ProjectBacklogFromMarker behavior, and explicitly preserving the existing control-plane admission gate (approval bypasses only parent decomposition re-approval, not claimability/canary).
atoms.test: Verify Add-ProjectBacklogFromMarker sets approved/bridge-self for children, and that existing control-plane admission gate is preserved (approval does not bypass claimability).

atoms.statement: Confine the entire mechanism to channel=='main' and scope=='bridge'; PROJECT-channels must not be affected.
atoms.test: Verify the mechanism only activates when channel='main' AND scope='bridge', and has no effect on PROJECT-channels.

atoms.statement: Define 'valid split' deterministically as (created_valid + same-parent skipped_existing_valid) >= 2 with errors empty, where skipped atoms are re-validated (same slug, source_task, non-terminal status) and cross-parent atoms never count.
atoms.test: Verify valid split is defined as (created_valid + same-parent skipped_existing_valid >= 2) with no errors, including re-validation of skipped atoms and exclusion of cross-parent atoms.

atoms.statement: Implement bounded decompose-retry (2-3 attempts) with ingest errors fed back to the planner.
atoms.test: Verify bounded retry (2-3 attempts) occurs on ingest errors, with errors fed back to planner.

atoms.statement: Consolidate implementation to one largeness-function, one ingest-path, and one gate-site, reusing existing components.
atoms.test: Verify the system uses a single largeness function, single ingest path, and single gate site for bridge-self decomposition.

atoms.statement: Rewrite the planner decompose instruction to require a [[PROJECT_BACKLOG]] JSON array with full atom schema (single file, acceptance, checks, admission for control-plane), demoting [[DECOMPOSED:N]] to informational, and stopping raw Add-Idea instructions.
atoms.test: Verify planner decompose instruction requires [[PROJECT_BACKLOG]] JSON with full atom schema (single file, admission for control-plane), and Add-Idea is no longer instructed.

atoms.statement: Implement a mandatory review gate step before auto-approval and dispatch of child atoms.
atoms.test: Verify a mandatory review gate is performed before auto-approval and dispatch of child atoms.

atoms.statement: Make PROJECT-channel non-interference the acceptance backbone, gating every change on channel=='main'/scope=='bridge', leaving PROJECT_PLAN path untouched, and shipping mandatory regressions (test-project-autopilot-stop.ps1, test-autopilot-controlplane-gate.ps1) proving PROJECT stays gated and unadmitted children unclaimable.
atoms.test: Verify PROJECT-channel non-interference via strict main/bridge gating and mandatory regressions (test-project-autopilot-stop.ps1, test-autopilot-controlplane-gate.ps1) proving PROJECT is untouched and unadmitted children are unclaimable.

atoms.statement: Adopt the durable MAP/PLAN's 8 file-level atoms as the authoritative commit sequence (one commit per file-atom), tracing contract decision-atoms in commit messages, and dogfood the feature's discipline: commit each file-atom incrementally, run Parser.ParseFile, focused tool test, driver -SelfTest, and smoke after each commit, including canary for control-plane atoms.
atoms.test: Verify implementation adheres to the 8 file-level atom commit sequence, with decision-atom tracing, and performs ParseFile/focused test/SelfTest/smoke/canary after each commit.
